) -> tuple[ExpandedRoute, ...]:

    routes = list(plan.routes)

structured.finding: No requirement covers when fallback shuffling starts. One should say that fallbacks are shuffled only when the route count reaches `min_routes_for_fallback_shuffle`, and otherwise keep their order.
structured.reason: The mutant compares the route count against `shuffle_fallbacks`, which is True and so equals 1, instead of `min_routes_for_fallback_shuffle`. Fallbacks therefore get shuffled even when there are fewer routes than the configured minimum, so callers see a different fallback order. The first route still stays first, though, so the sticky-start and stable-ordering requirements still hold, and no requirement says what the minimum-route threshold must do.
